state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The authors state that an ideal evaluation would compare final RLHF policies trained with and without critique assistance, but that this is expensive, so they assume that helping contractors catch more bugs will improve the resulting policy. They note this may fail because critics, while removing some human biases, may introduce new consistent label biases that degrade RLHF.
title: Assumes catching more bugs yields better RLHF policies; critics may add new biases
